description: Experience the Vibrancy of FAKE SHAADI with DHARAK  THE LADY
long_description:
Experience the Vibrancy of FAKE SHAADI with DHARAK  THE LADY
Get ready to immerse yourself in an unforgettable night of music, dance, and culture at the FAKE SHAADI with DHARAK  THE LADY event. Set to take place on the 9th of October, 2026, this Multilingual Night Party promises an eclectic fusion of Hindi, English, and Punjabi beats that will keep you dancing all night. Treat yourself to an exciting blend of Music, Fusion, Food & Drink, and experience a unique cultural journey like never before.
Meet the Maestro - DJ Dharak
Acknowledged for his soulful music, DJ Dharak is far more than just a professional artist. Music and rhythm are ingrained in his soul, creating an irresistible urge to dance till you drop. His passion for music is reflected in his mesmerizing beats, creating a vibrant atmosphere that is sure to captivate every attendee. With DJ Dharak at the helm, you can expect an explosion of beats that will keep you moving forever.
Discover the Magic of The Lady
Nestled in the heart of Hartford, CT, The Lady is a venue designed to deliver an elevated party experience. Located at 191 Ann Uccello St in the United States, it is easily accessible and offers ample parking. The Lady is not only a safe and secure venue but also conveniently located near top-rated Indian restaurants, making it an ideal place to enjoy a night of music and dance. With its close proximity to local attractions, it makes for a perfect destination for a night out in the town.
Pick Your Perfect Ticket
Join us at FAKE SHAADI with DHARAK THE LADY and choose from a variety of ticket options designed to cater to everyone. Grab an Early Bird ticket for just 15.00 or bring your friends along and save with our group options. A group of 5 can enjoy the night for 13.00 per person, while a group of 10 gets even more savings at 12.00 per person. Regular tickets are available at 20.00. Choose your perfect ticket and come join us for a night to remember.
